Title: Eyes of Blades vs Agg Strike + Rotschreck

Messages.Author: ira212@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
Hello LSJ,

Minion A plays Eyes of Blades at superior.  Minion B plays Burst of
Sunlight (or any other appropriate agg strike.)  Can Rotschreck be
played, and would it send Minion A to torpor?

I believe the answer is yes and yes, because Minion B is attempting to
inflict agg damage.

Thanks,
Ira
